name: m27_scan
notes: form_sensitivity_rms: rms over the pupil of sqrt(sum_j (2 n cos i_j)^2), optical path per unit normal sag error of the two mirrors. Ranking: sensitivity, then block length.

inputs.grid: r0 x y_c x phi0 x sign (see script)

outputs.selection: adopted: block length <= 500 um (CHOICE, comparable to the 0.40 mm refractive collimator); among those, form sensitivity within 1% of the lowest; then the smallest y extent of the light; then the largest smallest radius of curvature. TIR variant: both mirrors used beyond the critical angle over the whole aperture (no coating); same tie-breaks.
